## The fix

`fastify.js:395` — tightened the truthiness check to `=== true`:

```js
} else if (serverHasCloseAllConnections && forceCloseConnections === true) {
  instance.server.closeAllConnections()
```

Exactly as diagnosed in the issue: after #6669 narrowed the first branch to `serverFactory`, the string `'idle'` fell through to this branch and, being truthy, took the `closeAllConnections()` path — destroying in-flight requests under what is the default configuration on native servers. Native servers with `'idle'` now fall through to `server.close()`, which closes idle connections on its own since Node.js v19. The `serverFactory` path, `forceCloseConnections: true`, and the `kKeepAliveConnections` reap loop are untouched.

## Tests

Two tests in `test/close.test.js` (a 400ms handler with `close()` called at 100ms), one with explicit `forceCloseConnections: 'idle'` and one with the default config. Verified both ways:

- with the fix reverted: `fail 2`, both `UND_ERR_SOCKET` — matching the issue's report
- with the fix: `pass 24, fail 0` for the whole file

I had to close the undici client before awaiting `fastify.close()`; otherwise the now-idle keep-alive socket kept the close pending for the full 72s `keepAliveTimeout` and each test ran 70s instead of ~0.4s. A comment in the tests records why.

I also dropped a first-draft assertion that the default surfaces as `initialConfig.forceCloseConnections === 'idle'` — it doesn't; the default is resolved inside `lib/server.js:136` and never reaches `initialConfig`. The default-config test covers the behaviour instead.

## Co-change partners (per COMPLEX.md)

`fastify.js` is a hotspot; its map entry has no prose paragraph, only the front-matter lists, so I checked the `co_change` partners:

- **`docs/Reference/Server.md`** — no change needed. It already documents the restored behaviour in both places: the option reference (`Default: "idle"`) and the shutdown lifecycle at line 1546 (`"idle"` — idle keep-alive connections are closed; in-flight requests continue). This was a code regression against correct docs.
- **`fastify.d.ts`** — no change needed; `forceCloseConnections?: boolean | 'idle'` is unaffected.
- **`lib/warnings.js` / `docs/Reference/Warnings.md` / `lib/route.js` / `build/build-validation.js`** — unrelated to this branch.

Not committed. I could not run `npx standard` on the changed files (the command needed approval), so the new test code is unlinted — say the word and I'll run it.
